ic_name: TIA/EIA-485 (RS-485 via TI SLLA272C Design Guide)
notes: RS-485 transceivers are stateless analog parts; no chip-level calibration / trim loop is defined by the standard. System-level engineering parameters (termination resistor tolerance ≤ 1 %, failsafe resistor selection per eq. 2 of SLLA272D, common-mode envelope, stub length per L_stub ≤ tr × v × c / 10, minimum node spacing per d > C_L / (5.25 × C')) substitute for calibration at the link level. Test equipment of choice is an oscilloscope with differential probe, a TDR for impedance/stub assessment, and a noise generator + GPD source for common-mode robustness.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Eye diagram per Lane
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify transmitter output meets Figure 4-32 minimum eye-height/width; verify receiver input meets Figure 4-34 minimum eye.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Jitter budget
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Random jitter + deterministic jitter must be within the Gen 1 budget so the BER stays below 10^-12 after CDR.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: De-emphasis level
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: ≈ -3.5 dB de-emphasis on the first symbol after a transition; verifies the transmitter's high-frequency boost.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Common-mode voltage
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: ≈ 0.5 V at TX; AC coupling means RX can have a different common mode.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Electrical Idle detect threshold
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: RX must distinguish Electrical Idle from active signaling reliably.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: REFCLK jitter + frequency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: 100 MHz nominal; SSC modulation ≤ 0.5%; jitter budget split between transmitter PLL and reference.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: LTSSM oscilloscope decode
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Capture TS1 / TS2 / SKP / FTS / EIOS ordered sets to debug Link Training failures.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Protocol analyzer (TLP/DLLP)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Off-the-shelf PCIe protocol analyzers (LeCroy, Keysight) tap the Link via interposers and decode all packet classes for compliance testing.
